renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: pr_scatter
  title: Precision against recall per callset
  description: |-
    Each point is a benchmarked callset: its recall on the horizontal axis and its precision on the vertical axis, coloured by F1. It answers which caller finds the most true structural variants without adding false ones.
    How to read: points in the upper right corner are both sensitive and precise. A point high but far left misses true variants, and one far right but low adds false calls. Compare callsets of the same truth set only.
    Lines and annotations: the curved lines are contours of equal F1, the harmonic mean of precision and recall, and the diagonal marks equal precision and recall. They are mathematical references, not cut-offs, and Truvari publishes no pass mark.
  kind: pr_benchmark
  roles:
    label: label
    recall: recall
    precision: precision
    f1: f1

- component: card
  title: Callsets benchmarked
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of callsets with a defined F1, with the lowest and highest F1 beside it. It answers how many callsets were compared and how far apart they are.
    How to read: a callset without calls has no defined F1 and is left out of this count.
  column: f1
  aggregation: count
  aggregations:
  - min
  - max
  secondary_layout: compact
  caption: lowest and highest F1

- component: card
  title: F1 score
  description: |-
    The hero number is the median F1 over callsets, and the box shows its quartiles. It answers how accurate the structural variant calls are overall, balancing precision and recall.
    How to read: higher is better, and a wide box means the callers differ a lot. Use the precision-recall plot to see which side limits each caller.
  column: f1
  aggregation: median
  aggregations:
  - box_plot_stats
  secondary_layout: box_plot
  caption: F1 per callset, with its spread
  headline: true

- component: card
  title: Precision
  description: |-
    The hero number is the median precision over callsets, the share of calls that match the truth set, and the box shows its quartiles. It answers how many of the reported variants are real.
    How to read: low precision means false calls, which filtering the callset can reduce.
  column: precision
  aggregation: median
  aggregations:
  - box_plot_stats
  secondary_layout: box_plot
  caption: precision per callset, with its spread

- component: card
  title: Recall
  description: |-
    The hero number is the median recall over callsets, the share of truth variants that were found, and the box shows its quartiles. It answers how many of the real variants are detected.
    How to read: low recall means missed variants, which more coverage or a more sensitive caller can recover.
  column: recall
  aggregation: median
  aggregations:
  - box_plot_stats
  secondary_layout: box_plot
  caption: recall per callset, with its spread

- component: table
  title: Benchmark summary
  description: |-
    Each row is a benchmarked callset with its precision, recall and F1. It answers how each caller and sample compare against the truth set.
    How to read: sort by F1 to rank the callsets.
